method.prompt: Photorealistic, a barefoot girl of about nine with reddish-gold hair under a patched gray coat, clutching a bundle of matchboxes looks back toward the lit street, then shakes her head and crouches in the same narrow alley corner between two dark brick houses at night, snow piled against the walls, a single dim street lamp glowing, afraid of her father's switch with no money earned. Trembling close-up. Her chattering whisper in Korean, 빈손으론 못 돌아가, snow hissing on stone.
